notes.title: Lil Tanks Update! Version 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28285842/50a1ab58575e58c5209ef12e4051d50f60c12bdd.jpg[/img]

[b]Lil Tanks Version 1.1 is here![/b]

The first of two Kickstarter backer designed stages is ready to play!  Check out the new underwater level as part of this free update!

In addition to the new stage this update brings the following changes:
[list]
[*]New Enemies
[*]New Achievement
[*]Fixed overlapping issues with main tanks
[*]Fixed visibility issue with Wayne's special where enemies and enemy bullets are covered up
[*]Fixed bug that caused special ability to recharge when powerups are picked up
[/list]

We'd also like to announce a permanent price drop to $4.99!  We hope you enjoy the game and if you do, please leave us a review!  Thanks!

notes.title: Lil Tanks Update #3
notes.notes:
Hello all,  we've got another update for you today!

This patch includes the following changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed acid ooze hitbox, making it much smaller and easier to avoid.
[*]Recolored some stage backgrounds to help enemies and projectiles stand out more clearly.
[*]Removed three random tank bomb powerups from Wayne/Kim and created a brand new special for them.
[*]Adjusted time for "Survivor" Achievement and corresponding Mod Unlock from 10 minutes to 5 minutes.
[/list]

(These tweaks will also be reflected in the demo version as well.)

notes.title: Lil Tanks Update #2
notes.notes:
We’ve been hard at work making adjustments to Lil Tanks and doing our best to address some of the feedback we’ve received since launch a couple months ago.  We’re proud to provide another update today which makes the following changes:
 
[list] 
[*] Tweaked difficulty of final boss
[*] Fixed a bug that caused player to take damage before the last boss came onto the screen
[*] AZERTY keyboard is now supported
[*] Steam screenshots are now working
[*] Fixed a bug in Endless Mode that added any current score as your local high score even if it was less than the current high score
[*] Added a new cannon upgrade: Rail Shot
[*] Added a new passive upgrade: Swarm
[/list] 
 
[b]Lead Money Games[/b]

notes.title: Lil Tanks First Month Update
notes.notes:
It’s now been one month since we released Lil Tanks on Steam!  Thank you to all who have supported our game and provided us with feedback on how to make it an even better experience.  

With today’s update the following changes have been made:

[list]
[*]Added support for the directional pad on gamepad controllers.
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing “ENTER” or “START” on a gamepad didn’t allow you to exit the options screen.
[*]Fixed the high score display on endless mode
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the proper screen setting to be used upon restarting the game
[*]Fixed bug that was causing dialogue to be skipped
[*]Added player markers for when co-op mode is activated by second player.
[*]Player 2 Tank can now take damage when playing in co-op mode.  When hit, the tank will be temporarily disabled and unable to move or fire.  The companion tank will still be invulnerable while in single player mode.
[*]Edited Stage 6 to include some more enemies and a shorter lead-in time to the final boss
[*]Fixed handful of achievements that were not activating properly
[/list]

We hope to have our two additional stages ready soon as well as some updates to the powerup system!


[b]Lead Money Games[/b]
